description: Ap x Swatch... two brands, one industry, different worlds. Really innovative collaboration
transcript: Now hear me out. The AP Swatch collab is actually genius. Some people have criticised it, but I think what they've done is really smart. Swatch AP collab. Both watch makers sit at very different ends of the spectrum, AP being very premium, swatch being a much more mass market. And they produced a collab product that sort of mid price, exactly what you expect. Significantly more expensive than the mass market's watches, but still affordable to many people, particularly if it's like somewhat of a one off purchaser. Now, instead of producing almost like a hybrid version, which is what you might default think of, it's not a regular wristwatch, it's a pocket watch. And I think that's the sort of curveball the big brands can make that gathers tons of attention because it's not what people are expecting. Like it's a newsworthy thing and it's a sort of thing that gets other people talking in real life to their friends, family, colleague, etcetera. When you're making big plays like that, you have to think about what's the potential downside. So AP is a watch brand, they're gonna be negatively impacted by this. No, the people buying AP watches, they don't care. Doesn't even register. They're only thinking of premium watch brands. For the Swatch people, it's still somewhat of an aspirational buy. They can get a taste of something that they otherwise wouldn't be able to go near. So it's fantastic positioning from that standpoint. And the curveball Just means that tons of people talk about it. So what could have been quite risky actually may have been a really good move for them.
